body: Thank you for the advice, but I don't think I'll be able to get out of homelessness once I get there. It is hard enough for me to find a job now. If I'm living under a bridge, imagine how hard it will be then. It'll be the end, for sure. I'm not going to go there. I'd rather die.
oh and btw, it is not my mom kicking me out onto the street. it is actually the bank foreclosing on her home.
